_comment: #730 DUAL-SOURCE SYNC — Keep this file identical to /shared/xp-constants.json (KMP source of truth). Reason: tsc rootDir=src forbids imports outside src/. When you change values in /shared/xp-constants.json, copy them here. A CI test (test/xp-constants-sync.test.ts) enforces this. Consumers: functions/src/constants.ts, web/src/types/gamification.ts, web/src/utils/constants.ts, shared/src/commonMain/.../XpAction.kt, shared/src/commonMain/.../LevelTable.kt, shared/src/commonMain/.../XPCalculator.kt

xpActions._comment: XP awarded per action in a match. These are the DEFAULT values; groups can override via GamificationSettings.

streakBonuses._comment: Bonus XP for consecutive game attendance. Only the highest applicable tier is awarded.

leagueThresholds._comment: League division boundaries (0-100 scale). Source of truth for KMP LeagueDivision.kt, functions/src/constants.ts, and web/src/types/gamification.ts.

leagueRatingWeights._comment: Weights for League Rating formula: 40% PPJ + 30% WR + 20% GD + 10% MVP.

divisionColors._comment: Hex colors for each division. Source of truth for Android (LeagueDivision.kt colorHex), web (theme gamificationColors), and Cloud Functions.

levelTable._comment: Level definitions. xpRequired is the ABSOLUTE total XP needed to reach this level. Progression: Levels 0-10 (~1.5 years playing 1x/week), Levels 11-20 (~1.5 additional years).
